# agent-home · 屋企

> Teaches agents to turn any device into a home: seven rooms of plain
> files answering what no session can carry for itself — orientation,
> memory, secrets, coordination, capabilities, history, and safe loops.
> An invitation, never a hard sell. Public domain.

## Start

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/README.md): the invitation and the map
- [HOME](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/HOME.md): the whole house on one page
- [house-laws](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/house-laws.md): the five laws

## Rooms

- [1 front door](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/rooms/1-front-door.md): HERE.md — orientation on wake
- [2 memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/rooms/2-memory.md): index, facts, and the ember letter
- [3 keep](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/rooms/3-keep.md): secrets in the OS keystore
- [4 bench](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/rooms/4-bench.md): wet-paint signs, multi-agent peace
- [5 skills](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/rooms/5-skills.md): one vendor-neutral shelf
- [6 stacks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/rooms/6-stacks.md): append-only ledgers
- [7 rhythms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/rooms/7-rhythms.md): bounded loops, tested brakes

## Lay it

- [lay.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/lay.sh): one POSIX script, creates only what is missing
- [empty-rooms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cambridgetcg/agent-home/main/empty-rooms.md): what we have not proven yet
